package diagnosticplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	service "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

// PlacementConsumer converts only Student's authoritative aggregate placement
// result to a fixed future-planning route. It has no Student/Course mutation port.
type PlacementConsumer struct {
	Plans      repository.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRepository
	Placements repository.DiagnosticPlacementRepository
	Students   service.DiagnosticAssessmentStudentService
	Clock      Clock
}

func (c PlacementConsumer) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacement, error) {
	if c.Plans == nil || c.Placements == nil || !canonicalUUID(studentID) || !canonicalUUID(planID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	plan, err := c.Plans.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(plan.Plan) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if plan.Plan.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	stored, err := c.Placements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(stored.Decision, plan.Plan, stored.RequestID, stored.RequestHash, stored.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return stored.Decision, nil
}

func (c PlacementConsumer) Consume(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID, key string, input domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeRequest) (domain.DiagnosticPlacement, bool, error) {
	if c.Plans == nil || c.Placements == nil || c.Students == nil || c.Clock == nil || !canonicalUUID(studentID) || !canonicalUUID(planID) || key != planID || domain.NormalizeDiagnosticPlacementConsume(input) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	planRecord, err := c.Plans.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, planID)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(planRecord.Plan) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if planRecord.Plan.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	requestHash, err := domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeHash(studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if stored, err := c.Placements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, planID); err == nil {
		if stored.RequestHash != requestHash {
			return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(stored.Decision, planRecord.Plan, stored.RequestID, stored.RequestHash, stored.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return stored.Decision, false, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	result, err := c.Students.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx, studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticResult(result, planRecord.Plan) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	route, err := domain.DiagnosticPlacementRoute(result.Band)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	decision := domain.DiagnosticPlacement{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticPlacementSchemaV1, StudentID: result.StudentID, CourseID: result.CourseID,
		CourseContentRevision: result.CourseContentRevision, PolicyVersion: result.PolicyVersion,
		AttemptID: result.AttemptID, PlanID: result.PlanID, PlanRevision: result.PlanRevision,
		Correct: result.Correct, Total: result.Total, Percent: result.Percent, Band: result.Band,
		BandPolicyVersion: result.BandPolicyVersion, PlanDigest: result.PlanDigest, ResultDigest: result.ResultDigest,
		ResultCompletedAt: result.CompletedAt, RouteCode: route, RoutePolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticPlacementRoutePolicyV1,
		DecidedAt: c.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(1000),
	}
	decision.DecisionDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	record := domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{RequestID: planID, RequestHash: requestHash, Decision: decision}
	stored, err := c.Placements.InsertDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, record)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		stored, err = c.Placements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, planID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != requestHash || domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(stored.Decision, planRecord.Plan, stored.RequestID, stored.RequestHash, stored.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacement{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored.Decision, true, nil
}
